entities.name: Milk Mantra Dairy Private Limited
entities.type: wholly-owned subsidiary merged into the company w.e.f. 1 April 2025

industry: Fast Moving Consumer Goods > Food Products > Dairy Products

operating_notes.text: FY26 raw material cost rose 10.1% to ₹6,415.76 Cr while revenue rose 14.9%, but in Q4 raw material cost rose 25.5% against 16.6% revenue growth.
The company operates in a single segment, milk and milk products, so no segment information is disclosed.
Labour Codes notified 21 November 2025 added ₹10.23 Cr of employee benefit expense in FY26, of which ₹0.81 Cr was in Q4.
Q2FY27 raw material cost rose 42.8% YoY to ₹2,050.69 Cr against 21.7% revenue growth, cutting EBITDA margin to 11.44% from 13.89%.
H1FY27 operating cash flow fell 34% YoY to ₹678.31 Cr as the prior year's ₹419.26 Cr inventory release did not repeat.
The company declared and paid an interim dividend of ₹10 per share (1,000%) aggregating ₹222.75 Cr in H1FY27.
